text:
maria: Heads-up — chart load times spiked on prod around 12:20. /dashboards/orders on several users went from ~3s to ~12-15s. noticed after yesterday's routing tweak.

nate: seeing this too. traced to a burst of backend work and more CPU on the client. telemetry shows batch size up and more backend roundtrips.

maria: sample edge log: ```GET /api/metrics?range=30m 200 12000ms size=1.2MB cache_hit=false x-forwarded-for=...```

kevin: which route/policy did we flip? I pushed policy changes on 03/18 for quota-based routing to reduce cost.

maria: policy id pq-31 (by-quota-optim). It looks like console traffic got routed to a quant model variant.

sophie: pq-31 now prefers dedicated-quant-2 for some request shapes. that variant changes response shapes and also changes which analytics chunk we bundle (analytics-v2). that chunk added ~450KB to console bundle yesterday.

anjali: telemetry: big uptick in First Contentful Paint CPU on low-end devices and repeated kvcache misses for prefix keys. wonder if our cache key includes the model/route id.

nate: it does. cache key = sha(route_id + model_variant + prefix). flipping variant will produce miss storms until warmed. combined with larger bundle parsing = jank.

maria: quick mitigation idea: force console traffic to stick to the stable route (tag route console=true) while we address kv warming and split the analytics bundle. can we revert pq-31 for console?

kevin: doing rollback for console-scoped routing. creating rollout now.

deploy-bot: Rollout started: pq-31 -> pq-31-prev-config (scope=console). user=kevin. ETA ~45s.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: pq-31 rollback succeeded. link: https://deploys.internal/rollouts/6821

maria: post-rollback sample hosts show median chart latencies back to ~1.9s. KV cache hit rates climbed ~70% within 2m. leaving canary paused.

sophie: next steps (short): 1) decouple cache key from transient route/model name (use logical route fingerprint instead); 2) lazy-load analytics-v2 behind a dynamic import + fallback so bundle stays small; 3) add a pre-deploy check that flags bundle-size deltas > 100KB for console builds and auto-notify eng-platform.

anjali: I'll create the ops ticket and add owners: cache (nate), bundle split (sophie), deploy guard (maria).

maria: thanks all — good catch. adding a small telemetry alert for kvcache-miss-rate and bundle-size delta now :thumbsup:
